description: OpenAI-API-compatible text generation. The expected endpoints are POST /v1/chat/completions and GET /v1/models; suppliers MAY expose more of the OpenAI surface but consumers MUST NOT depend on it. Address the model as "pocket_network". Each supplier brings its own model and weights, so response quality varies and is not guaranteed by the protocol.

rpc_types.notes: Only POST /v1/chat/completions and GET /v1/models are expected. Token streaming is SSE over the same POST ("stream": true), not a separate transport.

serving.backend: Any OpenAI-compatible inference server exposing POST /v1/chat/completions and GET /v1/models. Bring your own model; no specific weights are mandated. The served model MUST answer to the name "pocket_network".

messages.content: Reply with the single word: pong

serving.notes: Use a server with continuous batching so one backend serves many concurrent generations. Alias the served model as "pocket_network". It is recommended to isolate the model behind pokt-ml-sidecar and serve SSE streaming through the HA RelayMiner. See the CONNECTION.md in specs[0] for the full runbook.
